chunks.title: Multi-Account Persistent IMAP Synchronization
chunks.content: ReachInbox supports concurrent multi-account IMAP synchronization with automatic reconnect backoff and keepalive heartbeats. It maintains an initial 30-day historical window sync and seamless transition to real-time IDLE event listening. All emails from distinct accounts are accessible in a unified interface.

chunks.title: Elasticsearch Search & Filtering Engine
chunks.content: All email messages, metadata, snippets, and headers are indexed in Elasticsearch. The system provides sub-50ms full-text search with relevance boosting across subject, sender, and body, with hit highlighting (<mark> tags) and strict exact-match filtering by account, folder, and category.

chunks.title: AI Categorization & Instant Notifications
chunks.content: Every email is categorized into one of five semantic categories: Interested, Meeting Booked, Not Interested, Spam, or Out of Office. Meeting Booked takes precedence over generic interest when a meeting time is explicitly confirmed. When a real-time Interested email is classified, automated notifications are dispatched to Slack (Block Kit) and external webhooks with persistent deduplication.

chunks.title: RAG-Powered Reply Suggestions
chunks.content: ReachInbox incorporates Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) by embedding company product knowledge and outreach playbooks into a vector index using dense vectors. When an email arrives, semantic vector search finds the most relevant knowledge chunks and generates contextual, professional reply drafts.
